snippet.title: Veinrider - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Veinrider is a short, incremental game where you upgrade a gravity-flipping mining craft and navigate through the caves of an alien world. Each run yields more resources you can invest into permanent upgrades, turning your fragile rig into an unstoppable mining juggernaut.

Play the demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4110670/Veinrider/
